Skip to main content
My name is Gary Wolff. I’m an expert, not a politician.
I'm a civil engineer, resource economist, and experienced leader. I've served the community as a board member and chief executive of public agencies and non-profits.
I'm ready to use my 40 years of experience to make EBMUD work better for all of us.
Water bills are rising steeply. Thirty-three and one-half percent (33.5%) since 2023; with a staff projection that they will be up 67% by 2030. And as climate changes, our water quality goes down. I have the skill and experience to serve the community by addressing these challenges and others.
### Ready-Made for EBMUD
Gary is not seeking a stepping stone to higher office. He is running to put a lifetime of water expertise to work keeping East Bay water clean, affordable, and reliable.
### An Expert, Not a Politician
Gary Wolff is a civil engineer with more than 40 years of water resources and sanitation experience. He has continuously worked, or been an unpaid professional engineer, for government, private, and nonprofit organizations since 1984.
### Proven Statewide Leadership
Appointed by Governor Schwarzenegger and confirmed by the State Senate as Vice Chair of the California State Water Resources Control Board, making water quality and water rights decisions that affected 36 million Californians.
### Hands-On Management Record
As Executive Director of Alameda County’s StopWaste, Gary reduced its fee-supported budget by about 14% while significantly expanding revenue through grants and contracts. StopWaste helps 1.6 million residents and more than 10,000 businesses reduce solid waste, energy waste in buildings, and water waste.
### Unrivaled Academic Training
Gary holds advanced degrees from Stanford and UC Berkeley in civil and water resources engineering and resource economics.
|
“Community health begins with clean reliable water. Gary Wolff will steer EBMUD in the right direction.”
(La salud de la comunidad comienza con agua limpia y confiable. Gary Wolff guiará a EBMUD en la dirección correcta.)
— Alameda County Supervisor Elisa Márquez
|
I’m asking for your support in the November 3, 2026 election.
Please vote Wolff4Water !
Thank you.
## Contact
I’d like to hear from you about your priorities for East Bay MUD.
If you have ideas, concerns or questions to share with me, you can fill out this form or email me directly at [email protected].
I look forward to talking with you.
By checking the "Send me text messages" box, you are agreeing to receive up to 3 text message(s) per month from the Gary Wolff for EBMUD Director 2026 campaign. The Gary Wolff for EBMUD Director 2026 mobile campaigns provide subscribers with updates, event invitations, donation asks, and voting reminders. Messages may include donation asks. Message and data rates may apply. Text HELP to 510-606-7538 for more information. Text STOP to stop receiving messages. See our texting privacy policy and terms of service policy here.
Text messaging originator opt-in data and consent will not be shared with any third parties, provided that the foregoing does not apply to sharing
(1) with vendors, consultants and other service providers who need access to such information to carry out work on our behalf (and who will not use such information for their own purposes);
(2) if we believe disclosure is required by any applicable law, rule, or regulation or to comply with law enforcement or legal process.
## Donate
Help me bring water expertise and leadership to the EBMUD Board.
I need to reach nearly 120,000 voters across Ward 7, and your donation will enable me to get my message out.
Please make a contribution today.
If you would prefer to mail a check, complete this form (click to open as PDF) and mail it and your check to:
Wolff for EBMUD Director 2026
P.O. Box 20371
Castro Valley, CA 94546
Thank you!
* The maximum contribution amount per individual per election cycle is $2,020.
